name: Phase 15-A depth local SDF offline validation
renderer: Existing simulator.build_scene; separate opt-in depth replay; paused timeline; teleport only; no physics step, worker or controller
depth_definition: Axial depth, not Euclidean range; USD camera +X right, +Y up, -Z forward; pixel centers u+0.5,v+0.5
observation_schedule: Every saved successful RGB capture (including busy/history-warmup); exact 72Hz pose. No new 4Hz interpolation or skipped-frame invention.
availability: Use original capture_end_monotonic_ns <= application_monotonic_ns. Never compare host and simulation clocks directly. Render wall time is offline only.
odometry: Exact recorded simulator pose; no odometry error
bounds: Same allocation as Graph v4: corridor xmin/xmax and +/-half_width, padded by 2m; allocation is not a wall constraint
occupancy: Nearest 1cm lattice node for every valid height/range-filtered hit; persistent union, no erosion, filling, inflation or map clearing
unknown: Unobserved nodes; observed occupancy plus camera-height horizontal ray visibility at lattice centers. Unknown does not create occupancy. Observation is not a certificate of full 3D free volume.
sdf: Euclidean distance to occupied lattice nodes minus 0.09m. Surface-only map, not signed solid-interior reconstruction. Bilinear query/gradient identical interface to Graph v4; error_bound=h/sqrt(2) only bounds interpolation of the grid-site distance, not sensor/occlusion/quantization error.
empty_field: Finite field-diagonal distance minus radius, zero gradient, 100% unknown; never silently treated as verified free space

noise.distribution: independent zero-mean Gaussian per finite positive pixel; negative draws become invalid; injected after float16 decode, before filtering

noise_note: Prescribed synthetic model, not a calibrated stereo sensor
path: Sample 0..7, observation-anchored world XY, nearest B projection + remaining native polyline; no B connector or switch reanchor
depth_clearance: Minimum bilinear query minus h/sqrt(2) minus half maximum path-sampling interval; conservative continuous bound for grid-site field only
oracle_clearance: Existing exact segment_clearance via path_safety, combined with footprint corridor distance. Oracle is evaluation only. xmin is a virtual boundary with no rendered back wall.
selection: Safe suffixes only, largest remaining arclength, tie lower index. No safe sample => null/ALL_UNSAFE, no fabricated safe fallback.
error_attribution: Diagnostic support at oracle-limiting surface: height-rejected hits within 2cm first; range-rejected hits within 2cm next; unobserved surface next; otherwise OTHER. Record all flags. This is evidence-based attribution, not causal proof.
timing: perf_counter: backprojection/noise, occupancy+visibility accumulation, EDT; update total is their sum; no rendering/disk/evaluation included. No benchmark reruns.
decision_order_noisy: DEPTH_CONSERVATIVE if dangerous_fraction <= 0.02 and update_p95_ms <= 50 and conservative_fraction > 0.20
timing_not_ready: Accuracy passed; optimize implementation and remeasure timing only in a subsequent task. Always report noiseless values too.
